quests.question: You won't get a refund ____ you provide the original receipt.
quests.sentence: You won't get a refund ____ you provide the original receipt.
quests.hint: 'Unless' means 'except if' - there is only one way to get the refund.
quests.explanation: 'Unless' means 'except if' or 'if not'. 'You won't get a refund unless you provide the receipt' = 'You will only get a refund if you provide the receipt'. 'Unless' already contains the negation - do NOT write 'unless you don't provide'.

quests.question: ____ you book early, you may not get a seat on the popular evening train.
quests.sentence: ____ you book early, you may not get a seat on the popular evening train.
quests.hint: 'Unless' at the start means 'except if' - early booking is the only way to guarantee a seat.
quests.explanation: 'Unless' at the start of a sentence means 'except on condition that'. 'Unless you book early' = 'if you do not book early'. It introduces the one condition that prevents a negative outcome.

quests.question: The installation will fail ____ all the required software is already present.
quests.sentence: The installation will fail ____ all the required software is already present.
quests.hint: 'Unless' means 'if not' - the software being present is the only condition for success.
quests.explanation: 'Unless' introduces the single condition that prevents failure. 'Will fail unless all software is present' = 'will fail if all software is NOT present' = 'will only succeed if all software is there'. Remember: 'unless' = 'if not'.

quests.question: She won't sign the agreement ____ the penalty clause is removed.

quests.sentence: ____ the temperature stays below zero, the pipes are at risk of freezing.

'Unless temp stays below zero' means 'if temp RISES above zero' the pipes are at risk. This is slightly unusual - but 'unless' still means 'except if'.
